research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Netradyne is researching intelligent driving monitoring and driver behavior monitoring, using computer-vision based methods for advanced driver assistance and autonomous driving. Work such as Combination alerts and Lane violation alerts detects co occurring events and lane violations to generate in cab and remote warnings. Systems like Virtual safety manager and Coachable driver risk groups curate video, classify driving events, and generate driver scores and virtual coaching. These efforts span driver monitoring, risk scoring, alerting, coaching, and edge based video analytics.

overview_description.description:
Netradyne engages in improving fleet safety through computer vision and in-depth data analysis. Through processing visual and sensory inputs, the company targets industries where the timeliness of actionable data is a key differentiator of performance.

There is a continuing technology movement that is driving rapid improvements in camera technology together with reductions in the cost of sensors, processing, and connectivity. These improvements, along with advancements in deep learning technology, have created a perfect opportunity to deliver vision-based solutions across multiple industries.

about_short_description.short_description: Netradyne engages in improving fleet safety through computer vision and in-depth data analysis.

product.name: Netradyne Intelligence
product.description: An AI platform for fleet safety, management, and fuel efficiency that analyzes driving activity, identifies risk and inefficiency, and supports automated coaching and operational decisions.

product.name: Fleet Camera System
product.description: An AI-enabled in-vehicle camera system that captures driving footage, analyzes road and driver behavior, and provides event evidence, alerts, and safety insights for fleet operators.

product.name: Driver•i Hub-X
product.description: An in-vehicle fleet telematics and AI camera device that supports driving analysis, safety alerts, video capture, GPS-related fleet visibility, and communication with Netradyne’s management platform.

product.name: Fleet Safety and Driver Coaching
product.description: A fleet safety service that combines driving-behavior analysis, real-time alerts, performance scoring, recognition, and managed or self-directed coaching to reduce risk and improve driver performance.

product.name: Fleet Management Platform
product.description: A fleet management solution that gives operations teams visibility into vehicles, drivers, driving activity, locations, alerts, performance, and service workflows.

product.name: Driver Drowsiness with DMS Sensor
product.description: A driver-monitoring solution that uses a DMS sensor to detect signs of drowsiness and support timely safety alerts and intervention inside commercial vehicles.
